label: DOWNLOADS, WITH CONTEXT
title:
Give Downloads
a second look.
detail:
Installers. Possible duplicates. Older files.
A clear place to start your review.

label: GLANCE + QUICK REVIEW
title:
A quick look.
A closer look.
detail:
See your Downloads summary.
Browse one suggestion at a time,
right from the menu bar.
note: Open the full review when you’re ready.

label: INSTALLER REVIEW
title:
Installed it?
Check the
installer.
detail:
A matching app appears installed.
Check whether you still need
its disk image.
note: A useful reason to review the file.

label: POSSIBLE DUPLICATES
title:
Same contents.
Your choice.
detail:
SHA-256 content checks identify
matching downloads. Compare the
copies and decide which to keep.

label: OLDER FILES
title:
Old export.
Still useful?
detail:
Find files you haven’t modified
in a while. Check the details
before deciding.
note: Age alone doesn’t make a file unwanted.

label: HIDE A SUGGESTION
title:
Keep the file.
Clear the
suggestion.
detail:
Hide a suggestion to leave its file
in Downloads. It stays hidden until
the file changes or you restore it.

label: SELECT WHAT GOES
title:
Your files.
Your call.
detail:
Select only what you no longer need.
Move to Trash opens a confirmation
for your selection.
note: A suggestion never moves a file.

label: CONFIRM BEFORE MOVING
title:
One last look.
Then decide.
detail:
Check the selected filename.
Confirm when you’re ready,
or cancel and keep reviewing.
note: Demo ends here, before a file moves.

label: TRAYAGE FOR MAC
title:
Less clutter.
More control.
detail: File review is free. Start at trayage.app.
note: Recover files before emptying Trash. Trayage never empties it.
